{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only updates test/functional/mempool_accept.py to align with new deserialization error handling; does not alter mempool data structures, acceptance, or policy rules.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not touch mempool code or policy behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes net_processing.cpp and P2P message handling to reject malformed blocks and transactions as deserialization errors rather than passing them to validation and disconnecting peers.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.68,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Prevents network-message DoS attacks that exploit full message deserialization before validation. As the author notes, an attacker can fit ~400,000 zero-input/zero-output transactions into a 4 MB block message to force individual CTransaction allocations, or send up to 16M weight in non-witness transactions; early deserialization checks abort these payloads immediately."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches fuzz and functional tests (src/test/fuzz/transaction.cpp, test/functional/p2p_invalid_tx.py, etc.) solely to test the new deserialization behavior, without altering test framework machinery.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Edits to functional and fuzz tests merely follow the core deserialization change rather than modifying testing infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/serialize.h by introducing stateful stream parameters (HasSerState and ParamsStream::GetState()) to allow mutable state tracking during deserialization.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds stateful stream parameter capabilities to the shared serialization framework in serialize.h. This enables streams to track cumulative metrics like block weight across nested object deserializations without violating streaming abstractions."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/primitives/transaction.h to add deserialization limits, but does not alter validation logic, chainstate, or consensus acceptance rules.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Does not substantively alter validation code or consensus rules; it enforces known block limits early in the serialization layer so invalid data never reaches validation."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 2,
    "bug_severity": 0,

    "leverage": 1
  }
}

As the author notes, an attacker can fit ~400,000 zero-input/zero-output transactions into a 4 MB block message to force individual CTransaction allocations, or send up to 16M weight in non-witness transactions; early deserialization checks abort these payloads immediately.

categories.rationale: Adds stateful stream parameter capabilities to the shared serialization framework in serialize.h. This enables streams to track cumulative metrics like block weight across nested object deserializations without violating streaming abstractions.
